messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Sudden egress failures observed from eu-west-1 VPCs affecting Hosted API and Dedicated pools (5xx spike + TCP timeouts). Auto-page to oncall. (2056789123)
ops-oncall-elaine: I'm on it — paging SRE. First glance: customer-facing traffic to external endpoints timing out, internal healthchecks passing.
sre-sanjay: I see spikes in connection resets and a large number of `ENETUNREACH` from our NAT subnets. Looks like route changes in rtb-0a1b2c3d triggered at 2056789001.
netops-jamie: Confirmed — CloudTrail shows a route table update by infra-deploy-bot 2056788999. The new route entry accidentally pointed 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw-zzzz instead of nat-abc (private subnets lost NAT).
platform-kate: omg. That explains external egress failures and bunching to IGW where SG/NACL block egress for private subnets. Are any SRs impacted?
customer-success-maria: Multiple customers reporting webhooks and embeddings timeouts. Dedicated customers in eu-west-1 show elevated error rates and retries. CS is triaging and offering status updates.
ops-oncall-elaine: Triage plan: 1) revert route table change or re-point default route to nat-abc 2) if revert not immediate, add temporary host-route to nat-abc on impacted subnets 3) notify customers and open status page. Who can take the revert?
infra-linus: I'm rolling back the terraform change now. Command:```bash
terraform apply -target=aws_route.main_rt_default -var 'env=prod' -auto-approve
```
infra-linus: Patch shows `destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"` with `gateway_id = "igw-zzzz"` — should be `nat-abc`. Rolling back.
sre-sanjay: In parallel, I'm adding a temporary route to force egress via nat-abc while TF completes:```bash
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-abc
```
netops-jamie: Doing the replace-route now — doing it manually because TF plan was in progress.
ops-oncall-elaine: After apply/replace-route, validate with curl from a test instance in private-subnet-a:```bash
# from bastion
curl -sS -D - https://ifconfig.co || true
```
ops-oncall-elaine: Also check Cloud NAT metrics and healthchecks.
infra-linus: Terraform apply finished, plan succeeded, route table back to nat-abc. Timestamp of revert: 2056789310.
sre-sanjay: I'm seeing connections restoring. Packet counters on nat-abc show traffic resumed. Services are healthy again in canary subnets.
customer-success-maria: CS: some customers still see delayed webhook retries; escalated to priority customers and provided ETA 15m.
platform-kate: Follow-up: confirm NACL and SG didn't get unintentionally modified. I see NACL ACL-0987 had an overly strict egress deny rule applied at 2056788890 by deploy-bot. That combined with IGW switch caused full egress outage for private subnets.
netops-jamie: Good catch. I'm reverting that NACL deny entry now. Command:```bash
aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0987 --rule-number 100 --protocol -1 --egress --cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --rule-action allow
```
ops-oncall-elaine: After NACL revert, do one more end-to-end smoke: run embeddings query and outbound webhook to slack.com from a worker in eu-west-1.
sre-sanjay: Smoke tests: embeddings latency normal, webhooks 200 now. Monitoring to confirm no regressions for next 15m.
ops-oncall-elaine: Notify status page and post-incident channel with initial impact: egress outage in eu-west-1 between 2056788889-2056789310. Some Hosted API and Dedicated customers experienced failed external calls and elevated 5xx.
customer-success-maria: CS posted an in-product banner for affected customers and sent targeted emails to Dedicated tenants. Follow-ups scheduled.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline paused for eu-west-1 infra changes. Auto-unpause after manual approval.
platform-kate: Handoff to postmortem lead: @sre-sanjay will own RCA, @infra-linus to prepare change list and TF runs, @netops-jamie to provide network diffs.
sre-sanjay: Will open RCA doc and link here. Preliminary root cause: combined TF change and a pre-existing overly broad NACL deny during a deploy window — sequence allowed default-route to point at IGW which is blocked for private subnets, resulting in egress blackhole.
ops-oncall-elaine: Incident declared resolved at 2056789380. Monitoring normal for 10m, closing page but keeping channel open for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
platform-kate: Action items assigned: 1) stricter guardrails on route table updates in TF (PR gating), 2) NACL deploys need a safety check, 3) incident runbook update to prefer `replace-route` rollback steps and preflight checks.
customer-success-maria: Customers updated; offering post-incident review calls to major affected accounts.
sre-sanjay: Creating postmortem — link will be posted in this thread when available.
ops-oncall-elaine: Thanks team. Leaving final note: small window, big customer impact. Recommend an exercise to simulate simultaneous route + NACL mid-deploy. :memo:
incident-bot: Incident closed (resolved).
